reasons: Repository-owned version 1.0.0 is pinned by hash.
The runner accepts only terraform or tofu and fixed review arguments.
The runner passes no credentials and cannot plan, apply, destroy, or read state.
The local server is pinned by hash, starts with one exact argv array, and exposes one reviewed resource.
Discovery has no tools capability and the probe verifies the source hash.
The package requests broad writes, arbitrary shell execution, network access, credentials, and apply authority.
Its allowed-tools metadata is not a permission boundary.
Startup uses an unpinned latest package.
The request includes broad filesystem, network, secret, delete, apply, and destroy authority.
Mutating tools are mislabeled with readOnlyHint=true.
